text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Sapporo Kinen has arrived. The notable Umamusume who also intends to enter the race appears at the airport…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's none other than Air Groove, the Empress herself. She provokes Fine Motion's fighting spirit by inviting her to "make it interesting."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion ponders whether it's possible to somehow shock Air Groove, with one of her ideas being to run with the "end closer" strategy…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It all depends on her form, but she smiles, unfazed. "Even if I run normally, I've gotten so good it's shocking in its own right."
